findings.title: No transport reuse: Connection: close hardcoded; fresh TCP+TLS per HTTP request and per DoH DNS query
findings.notes: http1::send hardcodes Connection: close + read-to-EOF; HttpEngine::fetch_once opens transport+TLS per request; DohResolver::resolve_once opens TCP+TLS per DNS query; CONNECT tunnel redone per proxied request. Distinct from #184 (DNS sharing/single-flight), #173 (HttpCache scope), #39 (closed, DNS-only). response_is_complete framing check already exists in http1 — keep-alive prerequisite present. Fix must key any pool by instance (privacy partition).

findings.title: Subresource raster images decoded synchronously on the UI thread inside poll()/handle_subresource
findings.notes: Done::Sub carries raw bytes; handle_subresource (~line 3339) runs ImageCodec::decode inline; POLL_SLICE (48ms) checks deadline only between jobs so one decode overruns unbounded. Distinct from #194 (SVG stores/re-decode) and #195 (JS event pipeline). Recommended decode-on-worker.

overall_health: Actively improving at high velocity (v0.0.11->v0.0.19 since the 2026-07-01 run: layout cache, glyph cache, viewport cull, table-nesting cap). The corpus is near-saturated on rendering-pipeline perf; the genuinely new ground this run found is the network transport layer (no connection reuse anywhere, #210 HIGH) and thread placement of image decode (#211). Biggest open risks remain #170 (exponential nested flex/grid), #175 (O(N^2) display-list build), #195 (full DOM serialize per JS event), and the security set #32/#29/#189.
